annotations.text:
Six directions for the mode nav. Every bar is live — tap the tabs, tap the Online control, tap the handle on D.

The constant across all six: Working gets Jobs + an Online switch; Hiring gets Workers + Post. Only the feeling changes.
A is the transparent one you asked for — blurred glass, spring-morphing pill, a pulsing hairline along the top edge while you are online.
D is the only one where the bar holds content, not just destinations. Tap the handle to collapse it.
The reference sheet below is the argument, if you want to take one direction to build: which slot carries what, per mode, and why.
